name: enhance-pa
description: A dark mode and a more readable style for the ProgArchives.com forum, as a browser extension

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --ignore-files test store safari PRIVACY.md 'icons/*.svg' README.md package.json package-lock.json
scripts.build: web-ext build --ignore-files test store safari PRIVACY.md 'icons/*.svg' README.md package.json package-lock.json --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
